prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: ONE original corporate logo SYMBOL for Chinese brand 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO, company 达州礼林生态科技有限责任公司. Its scope includes software, information systems, engineering, ecological and practical services; represent a coherent corporate brand, NOT a collage of business icons. Values 善心、善念、善行 guide accepting space, thoughtful structural joining and outward purposeful action. Graphic-first contemporary identity, memorable silhouette, medium optical weight with generous white openings, professionally balanced, easy to reproduce. This is a NEW independent design with no prior image as a reference. Construction direction: Contemporary CUT-OUT MONOGRAM SEAL, a bold solid near-square CORAL slab whose very large open white strokes derive from the SIMPLE 礼 gesture and two paired branching notches from 林. One corner is removed and the white turning path actually escapes through it. Modern punch-cut graphic, no thin lines or typeset complete characters. Low visual density with only 2-3 large white spaces. Palette: Coral red primary solid with a small near-black offset corner as structural counterweight. Flat colors. Output ONE centered standalone emblem on clean pure WHITE with generous margins. NO rendered company name or text: wordmark will be consistently laid out separately. No comparison board, captions, labels, mockups, texture, shadows, 3D rendering, generic corporate swoosh or extraneous pictograms. Do not copy any existing brand. Finish as crisp flat vector-like artwork with broad clean shapes.
